name: Golden Designs Andermatt 3-Person Indoor Traditional Sauna
description: Golden Designs Andermatt 3-Person Indoor Traditional Sauna Transform your home into a personal spa with our Golden Designs 2025 Andermatt Edition traditional sauna. Perfect for any space, from compact bathrooms to spacious bedrooms, these prefabricated saunas are easy to integrate into new homes or renovations. Enjoy the numerous health benefits of a traditional sauna and elevate your lifestyle. Start living healthier with Golden Designs today! Features 3 person capacity Pacific Premium Clear Cedar Wood Construction (Canadian Red Cedar Backrest and Bench) Interior chromotherapy lighting system Interior backrest with accent lighting Interior LED Control Panel with built in FM Radio and Bluetooth Connection Built in Performance Speakers Sandglass, bucket and scoop Stainless steel hinge and handle Harvia 6KW Traditional Sauna Stove with Built in Controls Specifications Electrical service: 240V / 30AMP (Stove) and 120V / 15AMP (Controls for Lights and Music) Please consult a certified electrician to install. Exterior Dimensions (WDH): 61″ x 50″ x 75″ Interior Dimensions (WDH): 57″ x 45″ x 71″ Assembled Weight: 400 lbs Shipping Weight: 480 lbs Ships in 7 boxes All Golden Designs Saunas Include a 5-Year Limited Warranty. View more details here. What are you waiting for? Order your sauna today and experience the Golden Designs difference.
